presence_pipe.name: Presence Pipe
presence_pipe.description: Two artifacts declare an axis called presence and share NOT ONE VALUE - dark_sphere's witness|hush|beacon|eclipse|becoming against magritte_pipe's pipe_and_words|pipe_only|words_only|empty_frame|picture_of_picture. The word turns out to be doing real work, but not the work the brief guessed, and the evidence is the TYPE of each axis rather than the meaning of its words. dark_sphere.gd:173-179 is a MULTIPLIER TABLE: ten floats per row, one builder, and no zero anywhere in it - hush is radius 0.55 and alpha 0.50, still there, and eclipse is radius 1.50, the largest row in the file. That axis is a scalar and cannot express absence. magritte_pipe.gd:63-64 is a complete 2-BIT TRUTH TABLE: PRESENCE_HAS_PIPE and PRESENCE_HAS_WORDS give (T,T), (T,F), (F,T) and - as empty_frame, in neither array - (F,F), consumed by two `if presence in ...` lines at :109 and :250. That axis is a bit vector and cannot express a degree. So the shared question is CAN A THING BE PARTLY HERE, and the two members answer it from the two ends: always-partly-never-absent against in-or-out-and-the-support-stands-either-way. This bench puts five rival answers to that question on ONE body in ONE place on a stage that never moves: a museum plinth carrying magritte's frame and canvas at their own sizes, and a dark body whose radius, 0.170, is derived from the painted pipe it replaces (that pipe spans 0.34 m from the bowl's -0.16 at :169 to the mouthpiece's +0.18 at :198). The world box is 0.90 x 0.71 x 0.54 m in all fifteen cells. No _process, no Timer, no RandomNumberGenerator, no noise: both sources animate and this one never moves.
dev_themes: a scalar with no zero against a bit vector with no degree
the all-rungs value was already shipped
the sentence drawn as its own bounding box
interactions: put standing=amount next to standing=likeness in the frame warrant. Same radius, same site, same material, same paint - and one of them has no volume. That is the whole of magritte's claim rebuilt without a word in it, and it is the pair that reverses under a change of standpoint: head-on the disc IS the sphere's silhouette exactly, and from the side it is a 6 mm line

walk the standing axis and watch which member each answer belongs to. amount and quorum are dark_sphere's (a magnitude and a redistribution of the same dark), likeness and denial are magritte's (a resemblance and a negation), and absence belongs to neither - it is the zero magritte's axis has and dark_sphere's cannot reach

compare standing=absence across warrant=frame and warrant=room. They are the same photograph, by construction, and that is the designed null: absence builds no body, so the whole of the warrant axis reduces to assigning a Vector3 that nobody reads. Then look at absence x apparatus, which is the same emptiness with a cage built around it - a warrant conferred on nothing

read the denial bar against the body it crosses. Rec.709 puts magritte's caption ink at 0.125 and dark_sphere's albedo at 0.077, 0.047 apart - the one gap in this sheet's luma ladder that falls under 0.10, and it is two palettes from two artifacts that have never been in the same room. The bar has to read by shading, not by colour, which is why amount against denial is the predicted floor of the sheet

stand at quorum in the frame warrant and notice that the six orbs OVERHANG the canvas. Their ring reaches 0.2295 m from the site against a canvas half-width of 0.35, and after the 0.180 m of parallax between the body's site and the canvas plane they run off the right-hand edge onto the frame. A quorum does not fit in the rectangle that warrants it, and nothing was tuned to make that happen - the ring is dark_sphere's own radius * 0.95 plus radius * 0.40
presence_pipe.capacity: SEE that two artifacts can share an axis name, share no value at all, and still be asking one question - and that the disagreement between them is not about vocabulary but about what KIND of quantity presence is: a degree with no zero, or a membership with no degree. Neither member can show this, because each has only its own five words on its own body, and one of them cannot build absence while the other cannot build a half.

spatial_needs.footprint_note: THE STAGE IS THE FOOTPRINT AND IT IS DRAWN BEFORE EITHER AXIS IS CONSULTED: a 0.90 x 0.05 x 0.54 m plinth, magritte's own 0.80 x 0.60 x 0.05 frame and 0.70 x 0.50 x 0.01 canvas standing at y 0.41 on two 0.014 m posts, a blank 0.34 x 0.012 x 0.07 caption plate on the plinth's front, and dark_sphere's floor pool at its witness radius of 0.204. THE PLINTH DEPTH IS NOT A ROUND NUMBER AND WAS NOT CHOSEN: quorum inherits dark_sphere's swarm ring at radius * 0.95 plus a small orb at radius * 0.40, so it reaches 0.2295 m from its site, and at the frame warrant that lands at z = 0.2645 against a plinth edge at 0.27. The plinth was widened to hold it rather than the swarm capped to fit - capping would have made the closest pair a fact about this rig instead of a fact about two vocabularies. Measured clearances across all fifteen cells: the apparatus foot ring is the deepest thing in the sheet at z = 0.2666, the denial bar reaches 0.221, the pool 0.219, the apparatus hoops top out at y = 0.5832 against a frame top edge at 0.71, and the lowest hoop bottoms at 0.0996, 0.0496 above the plinth top. The world box is 0.90 x 0.71 x 0.54 in every one of the fifteen cells.

measurements.source: computed_from_geometry against the constants in presence_pipe.gd; no Godot was run for this box. The extremes are the stage in x (the plinth at +-0.45) and z (+-0.27), and the picture frame in y (0.41 + 0.30 = 0.71). Every cell was walked on paper: the widest thing either axis draws is quorum at the frame warrant, +-0.2295 m from a site at z 0.035, i.e. z 0.2645; the tallest is quorum's upper orbs at 0.410 + 0.0714 + 0.068 = 0.5494; the lowest is the apparatus foot ring at y 0.085. Nothing either axis builds exceeds the stage in any direction.

dna.default: standing=amount, warrant=frame. NEITHER MEMBER'S DEFAULT WORD SURVIVES INTO THIS BENCH - dark_sphere ships presence=witness and magritte_pipe ships presence=pipe_and_words, and both vocabularies are declined entire, so there is no inherited default to keep. The default is therefore CHOSEN BY COINCIDENCE OF COMPOSITION rather than of word: `amount x frame` is the one cell of fifteen that is a shipped composition for BOTH members at once, a full-radius body standing centred inside a picture frame. dark_sphere's witness row is all 1.0 multipliers, which is a body at full radius (:175); magritte's shipped scene is a frame, a canvas and one thing standing in it (:106-114). Nothing else in the sheet has that property: quorum, likeness, denial and absence are each a shipped composition for at most one member, and room and apparatus are each shipped by dark_sphere alone. CATEGORY IS COUNTED THE OTHER WAY AND THE COUNT IS A TIE, so it is broken on a stated rule: magritte_pipe is `philosophy`, dark_sphere is `procedural`, one each. `procedural` names how a thing is BUILT and `philosophy` names what it is ABOUT, and this bench's subject is the shared question rather than the technique, so it takes the subject category. Said out loud because 1-of-2 is not a majority and should not be dressed as one.
dna.was:
THE VOCABULARY HAD TO BE INVENTED, AND THIS IS THE JUSTIFICATION. A synthesis normally renames its axis and keeps the rungs - assay becomes treatment and the values come along. Here the two members share the word `presence` and NOT ONE VALUE, so there was no list to inherit, and the risk was obvious: pick either member's five words and the bench becomes an argument for that member with the other one standing in it as a guest. The rule adopted instead was that THE AXIS MUST NAME THE QUESTION AND THE VALUES MUST BE RIVAL ANSWERS TO IT, and that no value may be one member's answer wearing a new coat.

The question, read off the code rather than off the prose: CAN A THING BE PARTLY HERE? dark_sphere's presence is a scalar with no zero (five rows of multipliers, hush at radius 0.55 still present, eclipse at radius 1.50 the largest of them) and magritte_pipe's is a membership with no degree (two booleans over two constituents, empty_frame the zero, no half a pipe anywhere). Both are answering the same question and neither can state the other's answer in its own vocabulary.

SO THE AXIS IS `standing` - what it takes for the body to count as being here - and NOT `presence`. Reusing the shared word would have smuggled in the assumption under test, namely that the two members mean the same thing by it; `standing` is the thing both are quantifying and neither names. Its five values are five DIFFERENT KINDS of answer rather than five strengths of one: a magnitude (amount), a number (quorum), a resemblance (likeness), a negation (denial) and a zero (absence). Two come from dark_sphere's constructions, two from magritte's, and the fifth from neither - absence is the zero magritte's axis has and dark_sphere's cannot reach, which is exactly the point of contact between the two.

AND THE SECOND AXIS IS `warrant` - what confers the standing - because that is the OTHER thing the two members disagree about and neither declares. magritte_pipe's entire apparatus is a bounded support: _create_frame and _create_canvas run unconditionally at :116-142 whatever the value, so the frame confers picture-hood on whatever is inside it and the axis is a question about the contents. dark_sphere has no support at all - it floats over a pool of its own light, and its beacon and eclipse rows reach into the ROOM through _add_presence_lamp at :588-619. That is two warrants, the frame and the room. The third is dark_sphere's own second axis: body=cage at :498-557 builds three hoops, four legs and a foot ring around the sphere, an apparatus that confers standing by having been built to hold the thing. So `warrant` is drawn from both members and from one of their own second axes, and it crosses `standing` without conditioning it - every one of the five answers is buildable at every one of the three warrants, and the cage, the pool and the site are computed whether or not a body is ever placed.

WHAT WAS REJECTED AS AN AXIS NAME. `presence` (begs the question). `mode` and `kind` (name a taxonomy, not a claim). `attention` (the brief's suspicion, and the code does not support it - see the note). `support` and `mounting` (this project's own rule is that an axis is what the artifact ARGUES and not how it is hung, and `warrant` is the argument that `support` would have flattened into furniture).
dna.note:
WHAT THE VALUES MEAN, WHERE EACH CAME FROM, AND THE ARITHMETIC BEHIND EVERY NUMBER.

THE FAMILY FIRST, AND IT IS A CENSUS BEFORE IT IS AN ARGUMENT.

  dark_sphere.presence     witness | hush | beacon | eclipse | becoming     default witness
  magritte_pipe.presence   pipe_and_words | pipe_only | words_only |
                           empty_frame | picture_of_picture               default pipe_and_words

Ten words, two scenes, two scripts, ZERO overlap. Checked: two distinct .tscn files on two distinct scripts in two different trees (commons/artifacts/dark_sphere/ and commons/interfaces/foundations/), not one scene wearing two names.

IS IT A FAMILY, OR IS THE WORD A COINCIDENCE? IT IS A FAMILY, AND THE EVIDENCE IS THE TYPE OF THE AXIS.

  dark_sphere's presence is a MULTIPLIER TABLE. dark_sphere.gd:173-179 is one dictionary, five rows, ten float columns - radius, emit, alpha, tint, halo_a, halo_r, lamp, gloss, rim, rim_tint - and _resolve_presence() at :317-339 multiplies the legacy numbers by them and does nothing else. Every value runs through the same builder. THERE IS NO ZERO IN THAT TABLE: hush is radius 0.55 and alpha 0.50, which is still a sphere; eclipse is radius 1.50, which is the LARGEST row in the file. The axis cannot express absence. It is a scalar.

  magritte_pipe's presence is a MEMBERSHIP TEST, and it is a complete 2-bit truth table. magritte_pipe.gd:63-64 declares PRESENCE_HAS_PIPE = [pipe_and_words, pipe_only, picture_of_picture] and PRESENCE_HAS_WORDS = [pipe_and_words, words_only, picture_of_picture], and :109 and :250 are the two `if presence in ...` lines that consume them. Written as bits: pipe_and_words (T,T), pipe_only (T,F), words_only (F,T), empty_frame (F,F, being in neither array). All four combinations, declared. There is no half a pipe: the axis has a zero and cannot express a degree. It is a bit vector.

So the shared question is: CAN A THING BE PARTLY HERE? dark_sphere answers always, only ever partly, and never absent. magritte_pipe answers no - in or out, and the support stands either way. One word, two type signatures, and the disagreement is the subject.

WHERE THE BRIEF'S SUSPICION WAS WRONG, AND IT IS HALF RIGHT. The suspicion was that dark_sphere measures presence as a property of the OBSERVER'S RELATION (witness, hush, eclipse) while magritte measures it as a property of the SIGN. The second half holds exactly. The first does not: NOTHING IN dark_sphere.gd READS A VIEWER. There is no camera reference, no proximity test, no Area3D, no player lookup. `witness`, `hush` and `eclipse` are rows of multipliers on the object's own radius, alpha and emission, and the only column that touches anything outside the object is `lamp`. dark_sphere's presence is a property of the OBJECT'S OUTPUT. The observer enters that file exactly once, in prose, in the `becoming` note at :181-210 - "what happens when the witness is ATTENDED" - and that same note says, in its own words, that becoming "is the only one that is not a quantity of presence... The other four answer how much of the room does it claim. This one answers a different question." So the observer-relation reading is true of one value in five, and the file already flags it as the odd one out. That is the second-most surprising thing in either source: AN ARTIFACT THAT DECLARES ITS OWN AXIS INHOMOGENEOUS IN A COMMENT AND SHIPS IT ANYWAY.

ARE `empty_frame` AND `eclipse` THE SAME MOVE? NO. Same rhetoric, opposite mechanics, and the code is unambiguous.
  eclipse      dark_sphere.gd:177 - radius 1.50, halo_a 2.20, halo_r 1.25, emit 0.00, lamp "drink", which _add_presence_lamp at :610-618 builds as a NEGATIVE OmniLight3D. The body is at its maximum size and it SUBTRACTS from the room. Absence performed BY a thing that is more present than any other value.
  empty_frame  magritte_pipe.gd:116-142 - _create_frame() and _create_canvas() run unconditionally, and _create_pipe() and the caption are simply never called. The container at full strength with the contents never brought. Absence performed by a container from which nothing was taken.
One removes light and keeps the body; the other keeps everything and never brings the body. Both stage absence as a positive object and they do it by opposite means, which is worth having found: the family agrees about the RHETORIC of absence and disagrees about its MECHANISM, which is the same shape as its disagreement about degree.

IS `picture_of_picture` AN ALL-RUNGS VALUE? YES, AND IT IS THIS WAVE'S FINDING - a source shipped one, and this bench does not add a sixth. The arithmetic, and it is not an argument from atmosphere: the value appears in BOTH PRESENCE_HAS_PIPE and PRESENCE_HAS_WORDS (:63, :64), so at the truth-table level it is BYTE-IDENTICAL to pipe_and_words - same two bits, same two branches taken. Then _create_inner_picture at :204-241 adds a second frame (0.34 x 0.26 x 0.012), a second canvas (0.29 x 0.21 x 0.006) and a 0.42-scale pipe; _create_text at :256-260 moves the caption to font_size 14 and drops it onto the INNER painting; and _create_pipe at :147-152 lifts the outer pipe to y 0.155 and floats it clear at 0.8 scale. So one frame contains a frame, a canvas, a pipe standing outside a painting with no caption of its own (which is pipe_only), a big canvas carrying no painting of its own (which is empty_frame), and a complete nested frame + canvas + pipe + caption (which is pipe_and_words). A still of it is a sample of the whole axis, which is the exact fault the all-rungs rule exists to stop.

AND THE MOST SURPRISING THING, WHICH IS STRUCTURAL AND UNDOCUMENTED. magritte_pipe.gd:63-64 is not described anywhere in that file or its registry as a truth table, and its own axis comment at :40-55 reads as five prose sentences about the gap between a thing and its name. But the two const arrays ARE a truth table, they are COMPLETE - all four combinations of two booleans are declared values - and the fifth value occupies a cell that is already taken. So "five values" is really four cells and a regress standing on one of them. Nobody wrote that down; the arrays say it.

DOES dark_sphere's SECOND AXIS, `body`, ASK THE SAME QUESTION AS `presence`? MOSTLY NOT, AND THE LEAK IS ONE VALUE. They are near-orthogonal in construction: _resolve_presence (:317-339) writes radius/emit/alpha/halo and the `match body` at :449-457 picks a builder, and the ONLY coupling in the file is `if body == "swarm": _halo_radius *= 1.35` at :332-333. But `body` is not purely a form axis. `cairn` (:560-582) "gives up the float" and "meets the ground" and is "roughly 1.35 m tall at witness presence, so it reads as a landmark from across the room rather than as scenery underfoot" - which is a claim about how much of the room the thing claims, i.e. a presence claim written into the form axis. And `swarm` "marks a REGION rather than a point" (:473-474), which is the same. So: two axes, one leak, and the leak is that the FORM axis contains two answers the PRESENCE axis cannot give, because a scalar cannot say "several" or "touching the ground". That is why this bench mines `body` for values instead of declining it whole: `swarm` became `quorum` and `cage` became `warrant=apparatus`.

STANDING, five values, each a different KIND of answer.

  amount    MAGNITUDE, from dark_sphere. One body at full radius 0.170, lit and emitting, at the site. This is the only kind of answer a multiplier table can give, and it is dark_sphere's whole axis compressed to one rung - because five multipliers on one sphere is one answer sampled five times, not five answers. Silhouette 0.090792 m2 in screen units.

  quorum    NUMBER, from dark_sphere's OTHER axis. _build_swarm's arithmetic verbatim (:481-490): six orbs at radius * 0.40 on a ring at radius * 0.95, with alternating lift (+radius * 0.42 on even indices, -radius * 0.30 on odd) so the ring reads as a cloud in a still rather than as a carousel seen edge-on. The same dark, redistributed. A claim no scalar can make, and the value that overhangs its own warrant: the ring reaches 0.2295 m against a canvas half-width of 0.35, and after 0.180 m of parallax it runs off the canvas's right edge onto the frame.

  likeness  RESEMBLANCE, from magritte. A disc of the SAME radius, at the SAME site, wearing the SAME material instance - the picture of the body rather than the body. It is the only value that requires the two to be indistinguishable from one direction, and it is NOT BILLBOARDED: a disc turned to face the capture camera would be the sphere's exact silhouette from that one yaw and a 6 mm line from the side, which is an axis rigged for a standpoint. Fixed in the picture's own plane it projects as an ellipse of area 0.7866 * pi * r2 at the canonical standpoint (the determinant of the screen map restricted to the XY plane, 0.8139 * 0.9664), i.e. 0.071417 m2 against the sphere's 0.090792.

  denial    NEGATION, from magritte. The body, and the SENTENCE'S OWN BOUNDING BOX struck across it in the caption's own ink. "Ceci n'est pas une pipe." is 24 characters at font_size 28 and pixel_size 0.001 (:259-261), so its rendered box is about 0.336 x 0.028 m - rounded to 0.340, which is ALSO the painted pipe's own width (bowl centre -0.12 minus radius 0.04 at :169, to the mouthpiece at +0.15 plus its 0.03 at :198) and ALSO this body's diameter. Three derivations landing on one number. Ink colour is magritte's caption modulate, Color(0.15, 0.12, 0.10) at :262. The bar stands 0.180 m forward of the site, 0.010 clear of the body's front pole, so it crosses the silhouette without intersecting the mesh.

  absence   ZERO, from neither. Nothing stands; the stage alone. This is the value magritte's axis has (empty_frame) and dark_sphere's cannot reach, and it is where the two vocabularies actually touch. It is also half of the designed null.

WARRANT, three values, each a different claim about where the authority to be here comes from.

  frame      THE SUPPORT CONFERS IT. Site (0, 0.410, 0.035): centred in the canvas rectangle, the body's rear face 5 mm proud of the canvas front at z -0.140. magritte's position. MEASURED CLEARANCE, AND IT IS TIGHT: at the canonical standpoint the body sits 0.180 m in front of the canvas plane, which shifts its silhouette 0.10458 m to the right in screen units, so the circle's right edge lands at 0.27458 against a canvas half-width of 0.284865 - a margin of 0.0103 m, about 6.5 px in a 760 px frame. At a larger yaw the body overhangs its own canvas. Recorded rather than tuned away: the parallax is a property of putting a 0.34 m sphere in front of a 0.70 m picture, and shifting the body sideways to hide it would be composing for one standpoint.

  room       THE ROOM CONFERS IT. Site (0, 0.3414, 0.015), floating free above the plinth over the pool, touching nothing. The height is dark_sphere's own: PLINTH_TOP 0.05 plus (float_height 0.25 + radius 0.35) scaled by this bench's radius ratio 0.170 / 0.35 = 0.4857, i.e. 0.05 + 0.60 * 0.4857 = 0.3414. Not a chosen number.

  apparatus  A BUILT THING CONFERS IT. The same site, inside dark_sphere's cage (:512-555) rebuilt at this radius: three orthogonal hoops at cage_r = radius * 1.34 = 0.2278 with a 0.014 half-tube, four 0.018 legs standing from the plinth top to the body's centre height, and a foot ring from radius * 1.30 to radius * 1.48. In the source's own hangar grey and NOT the body's material, because that source's point is that the apparatus and the thing it holds are different orders of object.

HOW THE SHEET IS PROTECTED FROM THE COLOUR TRAP, AND THE ONE PLACE IT IS NOT. Rec.709 luminance on albedo: canvas 0.880, frame and posts and caption plate 0.607, apparatus 0.479, plinth 0.301, ink 0.125, body 0.077. Every gap is above 0.12 except ONE - ink against body, 0.047 - and that collision is not a fault to paint over. It is magritte's caption colour (:262) meeting dark_sphere's albedo (:147), two palettes that have never been in the same room, and it is the reason the predicted closest pair is where it is and the reason `denial` has to read by SHADING rather than by colour. Every body in the sheet shares ONE material instance, so no two standing values are separated by hue; the denial bar is the only per-value colour anywhere, and it is inherited rather than chosen.

THE STAGE IS CONSTANT AND THAT IS A REPAIR. dark_sphere's own registry note says why: "presence spends part of its delta on radius, which self-cancels under an AABB-fitted camera; judge hush vs witness at a fixed camera." capture_config_sweep unions the AABB across a spec's variants and fits the camera to it, so an axis that changes SIZE partly erases itself. Here the plinth, the panel, the posts, the blank caption plate and the pool are drawn before either axis is consulted and nothing either axis builds exceeds them, so the world box is 0.90 x 0.71 x 0.54 in all fifteen cells and the camera never moves between them.

predicted_degeneracy.pair: standing=amount against standing=denial, in the frame warrant
predicted_degeneracy.metric: luma - mean absolute Rec.709 luminance difference over the hottest 5 per cent of the critic's 160x160 crop (1280 of 25600 px), as a percentage of full scale. NOT changed_pct: this pair differs by ONE opaque slab whose contrast against its background varies by a factor of ten across its own length, so a pixel COUNT past a threshold would rank it against pairs it has nothing in common with and would tie every pair that moves the same area. The magnitude is the whole content of the claim.
predicted_degeneracy.floor_or_two_sided: FLOOR. The silhouette arithmetic below is exact and two-sided - orthographic projection of a box and a sphere at a known standpoint, no shading assumed - but the four contrast terms it is multiplied by are albedo differences from a paper model with one light, flat shading, no shadows, no ambient occlusion and no antialiasing, and shading is precisely what has to rescue this pair (the bar is a flat slab catching one constant N.L while the body under it is a curved surface with a terminator and a rim). Every prior prediction in this corpus under-read by 1.5x to 6.7x. Expected measured range 3.7 to 17 per cent.
predicted_degeneracy.why:
THE CONTEXT IS THE `frame` WARRANT AND THE RANKING IS COMPUTED INSIDE IT, over all ten standing pairs, EXCLUDING the registered designed null (which lives on the warrant axis at standing=absence and is registered separately below). A closest-pair claim inherits its pool and its denominator, so both are stated: pool is the five standing values at warrant=frame, denominator is the union subject box, and the standpoint is capture_config_sweep's canonical yaw 0.62, pitch -0.26.

THE SCREEN BASIS AT THAT STANDPOINT. x-hat -> (0.8139, 0.1494), y-hat -> (0, 0.9664), z-hat -> (0.5810, 0.2093); view unit v = (0.5615, 0.2571, 0.7866). The stage box 0.90 x 0.71 x 0.54 projects to 1.04625 m wide by 0.93362 m tall = 0.97680 m2, and its diagonal is 1.2672 so the sweep's radius is 0.6336. At FOV 34 and PAD 1.9 the distance is 0.6336 / tan(17deg) * 1.9 * framing = 3.9376 * framing, and at the declared framing of 0.50 that is 1.9688 m, giving a frame 1.2037 m across - so the stage fills 86.9 per cent of the frame's width and 77.6 per cent of its height, and one pixel is 0.0015838 m. (At the default framing of 1.0 the stage would fill 43 per cent of width, i.e. under a fifth of the frame's area, and every number below would be quartered.)

WHY THIS PAIR. `denial` is `amount` plus one slab and nothing else - the same sphere, the same material, the same site - so the pair's whole difference is the bar, and no other pair in the pool shares a construction that completely. This containment is inherited rather than invented: dark_sphere's own body axis has it (cage is orb plus apparatus, :498-502), and it is registered here rather than designed out because removing it would have meant inventing a difference neither source has.

THE BAR'S PROJECTED SILHOUETTE, exactly. Box 0.340 x 0.028 x 0.012, orthographic silhouette = sum over the three face normals of area * |n.v|: the +-Z faces 0.340 * 0.028 = 0.009520 at 0.7866 = 0.0074881; the +-Y faces 0.340 * 0.012 = 0.004080 at 0.2571 = 0.0010490; the +-X faces 0.028 * 0.012 = 0.000336 at 0.5615 = 0.0001887. Total 0.0087258 m2. Its projected length is 0.340 * |(0.8139, 0.1494)| = 0.340 * 0.82750 = 0.281350, so its projected thickness is 0.0087258 / 0.281350 = 0.031015 m - about 19.6 px at 760, or 4.1 px in the critic's 160 x 160 crop.

HOW MUCH OF IT LANDS ON THE BODY, WHICH IS WHERE THE PREDICTION IS DECIDED. The bar stands 0.180 m in front of the site, so in screen units its centre is offset from the body's by (0.180 * 0.5810, 0.180 * 0.2093) = (0.10458, 0.037674). The bar's unit direction is (0.98356, 0.18055) and its perpendicular is (-0.18055, 0.98356), so the perpendicular distance from the body's circle centre to the bar's centreline is |0.10458 * -0.18055 + 0.037674 * 0.98356| = 0.018173 m - the strike passes almost through the middle. The circle's chord at that offset has half-length sqrt(0.170^2 - 0.018173^2) = 0.169028. The bar's centre sits 0.109663 along the line from the foot of that perpendicular and its half-length is 0.140675, so it spans [-0.031012, +0.250338] against a chord spanning [-0.169028, +0.169028]: OVERLAP 0.200040, i.e. 0.200040 * 0.031015 = 0.0062042 m2 of the bar lies over the body, and 0.0025216 m2 does not.

WHERE THE REST LANDS. The off-body tail runs from screen x 0.16297 to 0.24294. The canvas's right edge is a vertical screen line (y-hat has no screen-x component) at x = 0.284865 - 0.10458 = 0.180285, and the frame's at 0.325560 - 0.10458 = 0.220980. So 21.7 per cent of the tail is over the canvas (0.0005464 m2), 50.9 per cent over the frame (0.0012833 m2) and 27.5 per cent over the background (0.0006919 m2).

THE FOUR CONTRAST TERMS. The body composites at alpha 0.85 over whatever is behind it; at this warrant that is the canvas, so its screen luma is 0.85 * (0.0543 albedo + 0.0231 emission) + 0.15 * 0.8799 = 0.1978. Ink is 0.1249. So: bar over body |0.1249 - 0.1978| = 0.0729; bar over canvas |0.1249 - 0.8799| = 0.7550; bar over frame |0.1249 - 0.6068| = 0.4819; bar over background, taking the showcase ground at roughly 0.25, = 0.1250.

THE NUMBER. Converting each area to critic pixels as (area / 0.97680) * 25600: body 162.6 px, canvas 14.3 px, frame 33.6 px, background 18.1 px - 228.6 changed pixels in total, FEWER than the 1280-pixel window, so the window does not fill and the number is set by area and contrast together rather than by contrast alone. Sum of |dY| over the changed pixels = 162.6 * 0.0729 + 14.3 * 0.7550 + 33.6 * 0.4819 + 18.1 * 0.1250 = 11.85 + 10.80 + 16.19 + 2.26 = 41.11, over a window of 1280 = 0.0321, i.e. 3.21 per cent. Applying the lighting-and-tonemap compression the substance_room replica measured at 0.77 gives 2.47. REGISTERED AT 2.5.

THAT IS BELOW THE 3 PER CENT DECORATION LINE AND IT IS MEANT TO BE. Seventy-one per cent of the bar's area lies across the body it denies, where the two sources' palettes are 0.047 apart in luma, so the honest floor for this pair is low. What is expected to lift it is shading, which the model above cannot see: a flat slab and a curved emitting sphere do not take the same light even at the same albedo. If the measured value lands between 3.7 and 17, the design is working as predicted and shading did the work. IF IT COMES BACK BELOW 2.5, STOP AND INVESTIGATE THE HARNESS BEFORE THE DESIGN: (a) tools/check_dna_declarations.py, because a value the code cannot reach falls back to `amount` and prints two identical tiles; (b) the sweep's _rejects.json, because both exports are @export_enum String properties and Object.set() on a typed property of the wrong type is refused in SILENCE; (c) whether the sheet was captured at --max=15, because at the default cap of 9 the later axis is trimmed from the tail and `warrant` collapses to [frame] alone - which keeps this pair but deletes both halves of the designed null.

SECOND PLACE, FOR SCALE, so the ranking is checkable and not asserted: standing=amount against standing=likeness in the same warrant. The sphere's screen silhouette is a circle of area pi * 0.170^2 = 0.090792 m2; the disc's is an ellipse of area 0.7866 * that = 0.071417 m2, inscribed in the circle and touching it at two points (the singular values of the screen map restricted to the disc's plane are 1.0000 and 0.7865, so the major axis is exactly the circle's radius). The symmetric difference is 0.019375 m2 = 507.8 critic px at the body-against-canvas contrast of 0.682, which alone is 40 per cent of the window; add the shared interior at a shading-only difference and the pair lands near 25 per cent. TEN TIMES the named pair, which is why the ranking is robust to every shading guess in it.

AND A STANDPOINT CAVEAT, REGISTERED BEFORE THE CAPTURE RATHER THAN AFTER. amount against likeness is ANAMORPHIC BY CONSTRUCTION: viewed head-on down +Z the disc IS the sphere's silhouette exactly and the pair collapses to a shading-only difference, which would make it the FLOOR of the sheet instead of second place; viewed from the side it is a 6 mm line against a 0.34 m ball, the widest pair in the sheet. The canonical yaw of 0.62 is a middling view of a claim whose whole content is that a picture and a thing coincide from one direction. Run tools/probe_anamorphic.py --token=presence_pipe --axis=standing before believing any verdict about that pair from one standpoint.

designed_nulls.why:
IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION, AND THE CONSTRUCTION IS READABLE IN ONE FUNCTION. _build() runs in a fixed order: _build_stage() first, which reads NEITHER axis; then _resolve_warrant(), which for "frame" sets _site = SITE_FRAME and for "room" sets _site = SITE_ROOM and in both cases builds nothing at all; then the `match standing` block, whose "absence" arm is a bare `pass`. So when standing is absence, the entire warrant axis reduces to assigning a Vector3 that no builder ever reads, and the two cells are the same stage: plinth, picture frame, canvas, two posts, blank caption plate, floor pool. Not one mesh, transform, material or light differs. Predicted 0.00 per cent frame and 0.00 per cent focus.

IT IS NOT CONDITIONED ON ANYTHING PINNED. There is no dna.fixture on this artifact because there is nothing to pin: no _process, no _physics_process, no Timer, no tween, no RandomNumberGenerator, no FastNoiseLite, no NoiseTexture2D and no wall-clock read anywhere in the file. The only cached state is a static 64 px falloff image built from a closed-form expression. The null therefore tests the axis and not the rig's ability to hold something still - which matters, because BOTH SOURCES ARE CLOCKS: dark_sphere pulses emission and wobbles every frame (:274-310) and magritte floats its pipe on a sine and fades it above current_layer 3 (:301-319), so neither of them could have registered a null like this at all.

WHAT A FAILURE MEANS. Anything above 0.5 per cent is render noise. Anything above 2 per cent means _resolve_warrant has grown a side effect and the `warrant` axis is no longer a pure site assignment - check that before believing any other number in the sheet, because every predicted_degeneracy figure above is computed on the assumption that the stage is byte-identical across warrants.

THE CONTRAST THAT MUST HOLD ALONGSIDE IT: standing=absence against warrant=apparatus must be one of the WIDEST pairs in the sheet, not one of the narrowest. Three hoops of 0.028 m tube at a 0.2278 m radius, four 0.036 m legs standing 0.291 m, and a foot ring 0.031 m wide at a 0.236 m radius project to roughly 0.14 m2 of silhouette, about 14 per cent of the subject box - which is above the critic's 5 per cent window, so the window FILLS at the apparatus-against-background contrast and the pair should read above 15 per cent. A null there too would mean the apparatus is not being built, and would invalidate every cell in the warrant column.

dna.designed_nulls_why:
ONE NULL, AND IT IS THE ONLY PAIR IN THIS SHEET THAT IS IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION RATHER THAN BY CAMERA. The brief's own guidance was that an absence value is the natural null candidate, and that is what was built - but the identity had to be MADE rather than found, because the two axes here are otherwise fully crossed: every one of the five standing values draws different geometry at every one of the three warrants. So the construction was arranged to give the absence row the property, by keeping `warrant` a pure site assignment for two of its three values and putting every piece of shared furniture into a stage that reads neither axis. That is a design decision and it is recorded as one.

THE NULL THAT WAS CONSIDERED AND REFUSED, recorded rather than quietly dropped, because it would have been the more beautiful one. Under warrant=room the support is the pool, a horizontal plane; a `likeness` drawn in the plane of the support that warrants it would then lie FLAT on the plinth, at the same radius and the same place as a trace of the body would - so a picture of the thing and the residue of the thing would be one object, which is a genuinely interesting claim about what the room can warrant. It was refused because it is not true by construction, only by choice: making those two coincide requires giving them the same material, and a trace is darker than the thing it is a trace of. Forcing the identity would have manufactured a null and then reported it as a finding. The claim is left unmade and the fifth value is a plain zero instead.
dna.fixture_why:
THERE IS NO dna.fixture BECAUSE THERE IS NOTHING TO PIN, and that is worth stating rather than leaving as an absence, because BOTH SOURCES NEEDED ONE. dark_sphere runs _process every frame on 317 placements: it rotates the body at rotation_speed, wobbles it on sin(t * 0.4), sweeps the emission energy between pulse_min * emit and pulse_max * emit on sin(t * pulse_speed), oscillates the albedo brightness between 0.6 and 1.0 on the same phase, drives the becoming ring's scale and alpha on fposmod(t * 0.30, 1.0), and pulses the halo's alpha on sin(t * pulse_speed * 0.7) - six clocks in one function (:274-310). magritte_pipe floats its pipe on sin(t * 0.8) and fades the pipe's alpha as a function of current_layer (:301-319). A still of either is a fact about the shutter.

This bench has no _process, no _physics_process, no Timer, no tween, no RandomNumberGenerator, no FastNoiseLite, no NoiseTexture2D and no Time call. Everything is built synchronously inside _ready from constants and arithmetic on them. The one place a rate had to be turned into a number is the emission, and it is not a choice: EMISSION_STATIC = 0.20 is exactly (pulse_min 0.05 + pulse_max 0.35) * 0.5, the mean of dark_sphere's own pulse, which is what a long exposure of witness would give.

NOR IS THERE A GATE TO OPEN. _ready() calls _build() unconditionally and _build() draws the whole stage before it reads either axis, so the artifact renders standalone with no fixture, no host and no config - which is what dna.fixture would otherwise exist to arrange.
dna.kin:
The two sources are the kin and they are the most distant pair this programme has synthesised, in every sense except the word. dark_sphere is a 0.70 m purple orb placed in 748 maps across twenty-two sequences, whose own truth line is that "some things in a space exist not to be used but to be sensed - dark_sphere is a mood, not a lesson", and whose promotion note says the axis exists because the identity block had named a RATE as its critical parameter and a rate cannot be seen in a still. magritte_pipe is a 0.80 x 0.60 m painting on a wall with TWO placements in the entire corpus, whose truth line is that "representation is a gap pretending to be a bridge - computation runs on signs detached from signified", and whose promotion note says its axis exists because there was no way for a map to say which of the two terms is present. Three hundred and seventy-four to one in placements, ambient scenery against a thesis object, procedural against philosophy, and they have never stood in the same room: dark_sphere is in twenty-two sequences and magritte_pipe in one, and qfeplaboratory is on both lists only because dark_sphere is on nearly every list.

WHAT THEY HAVE IN COMMON IS THE THING NEITHER OF THEM CAN SEE. Each declares an axis called `presence` whose five values exhaust one member's idea of the question and cannot state the other's at all. dark_sphere cannot build absence - there is no zero in its table and adding one would mean an empty cell in 748 maps. magritte_pipe cannot build a degree - its axis is two booleans and there is no half a pipe. Each is complete in its own terms and each is missing exactly what the other has, which is what makes them a family rather than two artifacts that happen to have reused a noun.

A ROOM HOLDING THIS BENCH BESIDE dark_sphere is showing that artifact the zero it cannot reach; beside magritte_pipe it is showing that artifact the degree it cannot express. A room holding all three is the comparison neither member can perform, because each has only its own five words on its own body at its own scale, and one of them is furniture in nearly every map in the project while the other has been placed twice.
declines: dark_sphere's ENTIRE VOCABULARY - witness, hush, beacon, eclipse, becoming - AS VALUES, and the arithmetic is the reason rather than a preference. PRESENCE (:173-179) is one dictionary with five rows and ten float columns, and _resolve_presence (:317-339) does nothing but multiply the legacy numbers by them: radius runs 0.55, 1.00, 1.15, 1.50, 1.20 and emit runs 0.20, 1.00, 3.60, 0.00, 2.40 against ONE builder and ONE sphere. Four of the five differ from witness only in the size of the multipliers. That is a LADDER - one answer sampled five times - and a bench whose axis is the question needs five different answers, not five strengths of one. The values were mined for constructions instead: `witness` became `amount` (a full-radius body), and the two things that are not on that ladder came from the other axis (see the `body` decline below).

magritte_pipe's ENTIRE VOCABULARY - pipe_and_words, pipe_only, words_only, empty_frame, picture_of_picture - AS VALUES, for two reasons that are separable. First, four of them are the cells of a 2-bit truth table over two named constituents (PRESENCE_HAS_PIPE and PRESENCE_HAS_WORDS at :63-64), so as a value list they are one construction enumerated rather than four answers. Second and decisively, THE SECOND BIT IS WORDS: two of the four cells are defined by whether a Label3D carrying "Ceci n'est pas une pipe." is added at :250-265, and this programme's evidence is one still PNG per variant at 760 x 760, where that caption's 0.028 m cap height is 18 px. An axis whose difference is a line of text is an axis that photographs as a smear. The construction was kept and the text was not: `denial` draws the sentence's bounding box, at the sentence's own dimensions, in the sentence's own ink.

`picture_of_picture` SPECIFICALLY, AS AN ALL-RUNGS VALUE, AND ITS PRESENCE IN A SOURCE IS THIS WAVE'S FINDING RATHER THAN A COMPLAINT. It appears in BOTH PRESENCE_HAS_PIPE and PRESENCE_HAS_WORDS (:63, :64), so its two bits are (T,T) - byte-identical to pipe_and_words, the default. On top of that _create_inner_picture (:204-241) builds a second frame, a second canvas and a 0.42-scale pipe; _create_text (:256-260) moves the caption onto the inner painting at font 14; and _create_pipe (:147-152) lifts the outer pipe to 0.155 at 0.8 scale so it floats clear. The single frame therefore contains a pipe with no caption of its own (pipe_only), an outer canvas carrying no painting of its own (empty_frame) and a complete nested painting (pipe_and_words). A still of it samples the whole axis. Waves 20-21 found nine of these in the corpus; this is a tenth, in a source, and the point of recording it here is that the bench does not add an eleventh - the five standing values are checked pairwise and none contains all the others (denial contains amount and nothing else, which is a two-rung containment inherited from dark_sphere's own cage-contains-orb and is registered as the predicted closest pair rather than designed out).

TEXT, IN EVERY FORM, INCLUDING THE ONE THE FAMILY IS ABOUT. Neither the caption nor the explanation label is built. This costs more here than in any previous wave, because magritte_pipe's entire subject IS a sentence and its six `layers` strings (:67-74) walk from "Ceci n'est pas une pipe" to "Ceci n'est pas" - a real progression, and one that is completely invisible to a pixel difference at capture size. Two honest routes were available: build the text and accept that the axis photographs as a smear, or find the geometry of the claim. The second was taken. `denial` is the caption's own bounding box - 0.340 x 0.028 m, from 24 characters at font_size 28 and pixel_size 0.001 (:259-261) - as a solid slab in Color(0.15, 0.12, 0.10), the caption's own modulate (:262). It is the sentence with the letters removed, which is the most of it that a still can hold.

dark_sphere's `body` AXIS AS A SECOND AXIS (orb, swarm, cage, cairn), declined as an AXIS and mined for VALUES. The reasoning, and it answers the brief's question about whether presence and body are the same question: they are near-orthogonal in construction - _resolve_presence writes the multipliers and `match body` (:449-457) picks a builder, and the only coupling in 788 lines is `if body == "swarm": _halo_radius *= 1.35` at :332-333 - but they are NOT fully orthogonal, and the leak runs the other way from the obvious guess. `cairn` (:560-582) gives up the float, meets the ground and stands "roughly 1.35 m tall at witness presence, so it reads as a landmark from across the room", and `swarm` "marks a REGION rather than a point" (:473). Those are presence claims living inside the form axis, and they are there because a scalar cannot say "several" or "touching the ground". So `body` is a form axis carrying two answers its own presence axis is incapable of giving. Rather than import a form axis this bench has no use for, the two leaking values were promoted to answers in their own right: `swarm` became standing=quorum and `cage` became warrant=apparatus. `orb` is standing=amount and `cairn` was left behind (see below).

`cairn`, dark_sphere's stacked marker (:564-582), and this is the decline that was closest to being a sixth value. It is a genuine answer to the question - a thing counts because it TOUCHES THE GROUND, which neither member's presence axis can say - and it is buildable here in nine lines: three spheres at radii r, 0.70r and 0.46r stacked with 18 per cent overlap. It was refused because it is the one answer that CANNOT be given at all three warrants. A cairn resting on the plinth is a claim about contact with the ground; the same stack hovering centred in a picture frame is not a cairn, it is three balls in a line, and the value would have quietly meant a different thing in each column of the sheet. A conditional value in a crossed sheet is worse than a missing one, because the crossing is what makes the sheet an experiment. If this bench is ever rebuilt with warrant as a single value, cairn is the first thing to add.

`becoming`'s KIN RING (dark_sphere.gd:622-660), and the value with it. The ring is the only geometry in that file built for a single presence value, and its whole content is a REACH that widens and thins and begins again and "carries no state - nothing anywhere records that a reach completed, because a completed relation is a measured one". Its alpha is driven every frame by fposmod(t * 0.30, 1.0). A still of it is a fact about the shutter: the same variant photographs as a ring at any radius between the body and the pool's rim depending on when the shutter opened. That source's own note even says the alpha floor was raised to 0.10 so the critic would not call it INERT for a reason that has nothing to do with the design - which is a rate being tuned against a measuring instrument, and the honest response is to decline the value rather than to inherit the workaround.

EVERY LIGHT. dark_sphere's beacon builds an OmniLight3D at energy 2.4 over range 2.6, its becoming builds one at 1.9 over 3.4 with a slower falloff, and its eclipse builds a NEGATIVE one that subtracts light from its own neighbourhood (:588-619). Those are the largest luma levers in either source by an order of magnitude, and a single lamp on one value of one axis would swamp both axes at once - the tier_terrarium fault, where a headline peak of 8.02 per cent belonged entirely to one axis while every pair of the other measured 0.0 to the byte. Every difference in this sheet is geometry or albedo, and the lighting is the showcase rig's, identical in all fifteen cells.

`current_layer` AND THE SIX LAYERS (magritte_pipe.gd:38, :67-83), with their six explanations. It is a click-driven interaction state that advances modulo six and rewrites two Label3D texts (:330-335), and above layer 3 it also fades the pipe's alpha in _process (:312-319). Declined twice over: it is text, and it is a state a still cannot report. Note that the fade is the one place that state touches geometry rather than words, and it is a rate.

A PER-VALUE PALETTE, AND ANY CLASS COLOUR. Every body in the sheet - the sphere, the six orbs, the disc - shares ONE StandardMaterial3D instance built once in _make_body_material, so no two standing values are separated by hue and the difference between any two cells is always geometry. The single exception is the denial bar, and its colour is inherited rather than chosen: magritte's caption modulate at :262. It would have been easy to tint each answer and it would have been a gauge - the eye would compare five colour codes instead of five constructions, which is exactly the failure a union axis exists to avoid.

THE MEMBERS' SCALE, AND EVERY ABSOLUTE LENGTH WITH IT. dark_sphere is a 0.35 m sphere floating 0.25 above the floor over a 0.42 m pool; magritte_pipe is a 0.80 x 0.60 m painting whose pipe is 0.34 m across. Nothing here shares an absolute length with either: the body is 0.170 because that is half the painted pipe's own width, the float height is 0.3414 because that is dark_sphere's own (float_height + radius) scaled by the radius ratio 0.4857, the pool is 0.204 because that is dark_sphere's witness formula radius * 1.2, the cage is 0.2278 because that is radius * 1.34, and the swarm's ring and orbs are radius * 0.95 and radius * 0.40. The two things kept verbatim are magritte's frame and canvas box sizes (0.80 x 0.60 x 0.05 and 0.70 x 0.50 x 0.01 with its +0.03 local z) and the four colours, because the picture IS the support and rescaling it would have changed what the frame warrant means.

A BILLBOARDED `likeness`. Turning the disc to face the capture camera would make it the sphere's exact silhouette from the canonical standpoint, which is the most legible possible statement of magritte's claim and is also an axis rigged for one yaw - flat here, a 6 mm line from anywhere else, and a verdict about it would be a fact about where the camera happened to stand. The disc is fixed in the picture's own plane, the way a picture faces, and the anamorphy that results is registered in predicted_degeneracy with the probe command rather than engineered away.
dna.sweep_note: THE FULL SHEET NEEDS --max=15 AND THE COST OF GETTING IT WRONG IS THE DESIGNED NULL. `standing` is declared first and is never trimmed; `warrant` is second, and build_dna_gallery trims the LATER axis from the tail until the cross product fits its cap. At the default --max=9 the 5 x 3 sheet renders as 5 x 1 = the `frame` warrant alone, which keeps the pre-registered closest pair but deletes BOTH HALVES of the designed null (which is absence x frame against absence x room) and both of the warrants this bench added - the free-floating body over its own pool, and the caged specimen. There would then be no identity anywhere in the sheet, and therefore no way to tell a real 0.00 per cent from a broken one. At --max=10 the sheet is 5 x 2 and the null is intact but the apparatus column is gone, taking with it the contrast that proves the null is a null rather than a stuck rig. Only 15 carries the experiment, and 15 is the whole cross product, so no cap between 5 and 14 produces a smaller sheet rather than a ragged one.
